MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug feels useful because it could let me control a compatible lamp through the Echo devices I already use.",
    "The doorbell and WYZE Cam v3 offer new security functions alongside my existing door alarms, and their Alexa support fits my recent device purchases."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Both Fire TV sticks and the Echo Show 8 fit my interests, but my recent 4K Max bundle and Echo Show 5 already cover those needs.",
    "The earbuds do not address a current need, and the stylus assumes I have a compatible iPad when my history does not establish that.",
    "The WYZE Cam v2 and Blink XT2 interest me less right now because I would try the doorbell and v3 before adding more cameras."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Alexa purchases seem to be taken as a reason to suggest more Alexa devices even when they repeat functions I already have.",
    "My interest in electronics seems to stretch too far into personal audio and tablet accessories without a clear connection to what I currently use."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter because they show which needs I have already filled; the Echo Show stand also suggests I am equipping my existing display.",
    "Compatibility and a specific practical purpose matter to me: a useful addition to equipment I own is more appealing than another broadly related gadget.",
    "For security devices, placement and power requirements affect whether I would actually choose one, and I would start with a small setup before expanding."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my Alexa and practical home-electronics interests, but miss the difference between adding a useful function and duplicating a recent purchase."
}
